question: What Are the Causes, Effects and Prevention of Electrical Shock?
body_html:
Electrical shock occurs when current flows through the body from a live conductor to earth or another conductor at a different potential. Common causes are direct contact, faulty equipment casings, step voltage and induced voltage.

Body currentEffect (IEC 60479-1)
Below 0.5 mANo perceptible effect
0.5 to 10 mATingling, let go threshold at 5 to 10 mA
10 to 30 mAMuscle contraction, breathing difficulty
Above 30 mAVentricular fibrillation possible, burns

Prevention relies on insulation, guarding, isolation, earthing, equipotential bonding and 30 mA RCDs.
